description: Reads an e-invoice (CII, UBL, XRechnung or Peppol XML, or a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF) into the structured invoice object that create_invoice accepts, with money in integer minor units. Use it to answer questions about a received invoice, to edit one, or to re-issue it with create_invoice. It does not check any rules, so use validate_invoice for that, and convert_invoice to change syntax directly. For a PDF, `visibleTotals` shows whether the totals printed on the page match the embedded XML, which exposes a tampered or mismatched PDF. A document it cannot read comes back as an error result with the reason. Runs locally.

pdfBase64.description: A Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF/A-3 as base64; the embedded XML is used. Provide this OR xml.

xml.description: The invoice as XML text (CII, UBL Invoice/CreditNote, XRechnung, Peppol BIS). Provide this OR pdfBase64.

name: parse_invoice

embeddedFilename.description: PDF only: name of the embedded XML that was read.

invoice.description: The Invoice object, in the shape of the create_invoice input schema.

origin.description: Whether the input was XML or a PDF.

visibleTotals.description: PDF only: comparison of the printed totals with the embedded XML.

title: Parse an e-invoice into JSON
